title: Canonical identity scalar-extension twist comparison
statement: The section-normalized identity pullback comparison of every Proj twisting sheaf satisfies the normalized scalar-extension fraction rule.

source.place: Tags 01MY and 01N2, the identity scalar-extension fraction formula.

proof.text: Apply the canonical identity section evaluation lemma to the normalized identity pullback of the section. The identity graded-ring homomorphism maps each denominator and numerator to itself. Pointwise scalar linearity converts the left side to the coefficient times the original section value, and the supplied denominator equation gives the required fraction rule.

proof_origin.place: Tags 01MY and 01N2; reduced through the canonical identity section evaluation.

mathlib_searches.results: No existing theorem states the canonical identity normalized fraction rule.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarExtension_twist_canonical_identity
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    {σ : Type u} [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A]
    {𝒜 : ℕ → σ} [GradedRing 𝒜] :
    IsScalarExtensionTwistComparison (GradedRingHom.id 𝒜) (𝟙 (Proj 𝒜))
      (fun j ↦ (tensorPullbackSectionId (Proj 𝒜)).app (twist 𝒜 j))
